function.name: uber_eat_order

quantities.description: List of quantities corresponding to each selected item, aligned by index with the 'items' array. If not specified, a default quantity of 1 is assumed for each item.

function.name: uber_ride
function.description: Find a suitable Uber ride for customers based on their location, selected ride type, and maximum wait time. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.
